evidence.observation: H701 reads 285.6 °C while H702 reads 61.9 °C and the reboiler vessel reads 52.5 °C; H701 is an isolated high-temperature outlier.
The large discrepancy persists: H701 291.9 °C, H702 76.9 °C, vessel 68.3 °C; these readings cannot distinguish actual local overheating from temperature-measurement error.
System pressure 395.5 mbar, column differential pressure 0.2 mbar, buffer differential pressure 1.9 mbar, and cooling-water flow 5.8 show no accompanying pressure escalation or cooling loss.
Distillate flow is 0.5 and reflux flow remains zero; no composition measurement has been supplied.

args.missing_evidence: Independent H701 temperature measurement, heater power and setpoint records, and permitted heater-to-vessel temperature differences are needed to distinguish a sensor fault from actual overheating or intended heater operation; protocol phase and reflux target are needed to evaluate zero reflux, and composition analysis is needed to assess separation.
